name: microdoppler_drone
description: Drone micro-Doppler slow-time sequence: line-blade (sinc) rotor model (Martin & Mulgrew 1990) in scene.Drone(blade_model='line'). 2 rotors x 2 blades, 9000 rpm, hovering at 6 m boresight. Each blade is one uniform line scatterer weighted by sinc(Phi), Phi = (2*pi/lambda)*(seg . p_hat); the rotor flashes modulate the slow-time signal. Stored: the full noiseless beat cube and the range-FFT slow-time y[m] at the target range bin (Hann range window, Sigma(w)-normalised). The web engine reproduces it via the ported line-blade model (sim/targets.ts drone + the sinc weighting in sim/synth.ts).

target.note: rotorZ=0.05 m and the rotor-hub angles pi/4 + 2*pi*i/nRotors are the scene.Drone defaults; rotor i spins at (-1)^i * 2*pi*rpm/60; blade k at angle 2*pi*k/nBlades + spin*t; one line scatterer per blade centred at r0+(L-r0)/2 with segment (L-r0)*(cos,sin,0) in the rotor plane.

microDoppler.note: flash rate = N_b*f_rot (even N_b); max micro-Doppler 2*v_tip/lambda (may alias: |v_tip| > vmax here, as for real counter-UAS geometries).

slowTime.note: y[m] = range_fft(cube, 'hann')[0, m, rangeBin]; the micro-Doppler slow-time signal (before the Doppler FFT).
